title: Black Friday 2026 UK live deals: the best offers right now
seoTitle: Black Friday 2026 UK: Best Live Deals (Updated Today)
description: The best genuine UK Black Friday 2026 deals live right now, checked three times a day. Tech, home, beauty and toys, with prices compared.
intro:
**Last checked: Wednesday 25 November, 10am.** The three standouts right now: the **AirPods Pro 3 at £165** at Amazon (still their lowest ever), the **LG C6 65-inch OLED TV at £1,645** at Amazon (a new low this morning), and the **Ring Battery Doorbell plus Indoor Camera for £39.99** at Amazon.

Black Friday is the day after tomorrow, Friday 27 November, and Amazon's Black Friday Week runs until 30 November. We check this page three times a day and remove anything that has sold out or gone back up. This morning we added the LG C6 OLED (£1,645), a Blink Outdoor 4 + Mini camera bundle (£24.99), the iPhone Air (£799, £300 off), a DualSense controller (£42.99), the Ninja Creami Soft Serve (£179), a Kärcher window vac (£38.99) and the Nutribullet Portable (£29), all at Amazon. The Garmin fēnix 8 is now £479.99 and the AirTag 4-pack £71.78. We took off deals we couldn't re-confirm since 23 November (Apple Watch Ultra 3, JBL Live 780NC, Bose QC Ultra, Sony WH-CH520, Kindle Colorsoft, Dyson V8 Origin, Sonicare DiamondClean 9000). **PS5 buyers:** consoles are still in short supply since GTA VI launched; see our [PS5 guide](/guides/ps5-black-friday-deals-2026/) before paying a reseller's price. Prices were reported on 24 and 25 November, so check the retailer's page before you buy. Many Amazon prices need Prime: a [free Prime trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the whole sale.

body:
## Tech

Amazon's own devices lead again: the new Kindle is a record-low £119.99, the Fire TV Stick 4K is its cheapest yet at £31.99 (the 4K Max is £46.99), the Ring doorbell bundle is £39.99 and a Blink Outdoor 4 with a free Blink Mini 2K+ is £24.99. For Apple, the AirPods Pro 3 are still £165, the iPhone Air is £300 off at £799 and a 4-pack of AirTags is £71.78. The reMarkable 2 writing tablet bundle is a record-low £399, and the Garmin fēnix 8 (47mm) is £479.99.

For audio, the Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 are their lowest yet at £126 and the Bose QuietComfort Earbuds are £99. Sony's PS-LX3BT turntable is £199. For TVs, the LG C6 65-inch OLED dropped to £1,645 this morning, the TCL P8L 65-inch Mini LED is £699 and the Amazon Ember 50-inch £269.99. Gamers: the Switch 2 with Switch Sports Resort is £399 and a DualSense is £42.99, but PS5 consoles are hard to find at the normal price.

More: [Kindle](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Ring doorbells](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/), [AirPods](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/), [TVs](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/), [PS5](/guides/ps5-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Switch 2](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Amazon Black Friday 2026](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/).

## Home & kitchen

The Ninja Crispi glass air fryer is £99, below last year's Black Friday price, the Ninja Creami Soft Serve is £170 off at £179 and the Ninja StaySharp knife block is £109.99. The Kärcher WV 2 Plus N window vac is under £40 for winter condensation, and the Nutribullet Portable blender is £29. TechRadar also says the Ninja AF300UK dual-zone air fryer is at its lowest of the year at Amazon.

More: [air fryers](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Ninja](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/), [coffee machines](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Dyson](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Shark](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## Beauty

The best beauty deal today is the Oral-B iO Series 3 electric toothbrush at £49.99 at Amazon. For hair, see our [Dyson Airwrap price guide](/guides/dyson-airwrap-deals-uk/) for today's Airwrap prices. For fragrance gifts, [compare Amazon's perfume gift set prices](https://www.amazon.co.uk/s?k=perfume+gift+set) before you buy.

More: [perfume gift sets](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/), [ghd](/guides/ghd-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Oral-B](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## Toys & gifts

Advent calendars need to arrive by 1 December, so buy those now. The Lego Classic Large Creative Brick Box is £28.99 at Amazon, an easy gift for almost any age, and the Lego Game Boy is £35.99 for adult fans. For readers, an [Audible membership](/guides/audible-free-trial-deals-uk/) is £0.99 a month for three months until 17 December and can be given as a gift. For toys, Hamleys is running its own Black Friday event, and our guide shows what's worth buying there.

More: [Hamleys Black Friday 2026](/guides/hamleys-black-friday-2026/), [Lego](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Lego advent calendars](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/), [Nintendo Switch 2](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [PS5](/guides/ps5-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## How we pick these deals

Every price comes from the retailer or a trusted deals source dated today or yesterday. We compare it with price history and last year's Black Friday prices, and we leave out deals where the 'was' price is inflated. When Amazon matches the cheapest shop, we link Amazon. Many Amazon prices need Prime during Black Friday Week; our [Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how to time a trial.

### When is Black Friday 2026 in the UK?

Friday 27 November, with Cyber Monday on 30 November. Our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) lists every retailer's dates.

### Should I buy now or wait for Black Friday?

If a deal here is marked 'Lowest price', it's already at or below last year's Black Friday price, so buy it. Items marked 'Good price' could still fall a little in the final week.

### How often is this page updated?

Three times a day, every day until Cyber Monday. Deals that end or go up in price are removed.

See [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/) for brand-by-brand prices.
